title: Fingerprint or iris did not match Aadhaar
explain: The scan taken now did not match the biometrics stored with Aadhaar. This is common for older people whose fingerprints have worn down.

fix.action: Try again with a different finger, or use iris or face authentication instead.
If it keeps failing, update biometrics at an Aadhaar centre, then retry after the update is processed.
If the deadline is close, submit a physical life certificate at the branch that pays the pension instead.
